candidates.label: Creation from sperm-drop mixture for trial with hearing and sight
candidates.definition: In 76:1-2: Has there not come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing even mentioned; indeed We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him and We made him hearing and seeing.

evidence.excerpt: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينٞ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـٔٗا مَّذۡكُورًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Guidance offered leaving humanity divided between gratitude and ingratitude
candidates.definition: In 76:3: Indeed We guided him to the way be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرٗا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Hidayah as revealed guidance followed by ikhtiyar.

candidates.label: Selfless feeding for Allah's countenance alone without expecting return
candidates.definition: In 76:8-10: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy the orphan and the captive; saying we feed you only for the countenance of Allah we wish not from you reward or gratitude; indeed We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful.

evidence.excerpt: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينٗا وَيَتِيمٗا وَأَسِيرًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَلَا شُكُورًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسٗا قَمۡطَرِيرٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Kafur spring, Salsabeel fountain and eternal youths as Paradise provisions
candidates.definition: In 76:5-6,17-19: Indeed the righteous will drink from a cup of wine whose mixture is of Kafur; a spring of which the servants of Allah will drink they will make it gush forth in force and abundance; and they will be given to drink a cup of wine whose mixture is of ginger from a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel; there will circulate among them young boys made eternal when you see them you would think them as beautiful as scattered pearls.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَأۡسٖ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Earned reward declared after patient endurance
candidates.definition: In 76:22: And it will be said indeed this is for you a reward and your effort has been appreciated.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Progressive Quran revelation with patience and worship commands
candidates.definition: In 76:23-26: Indeed it is We who have sent down to you O Muhammad the Quran progressively; so be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful disbeliever; and mention the name of your Lord morning and evening; and during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long part of the night.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلٗا

candidates.label: Human willing nested under divine will with knowledge and wisdom
candidates.definition: In 76:29-31: Indeed this is a reminder so he who wills may take to his Lord a way; and you do not will except that Allah wills indeed Allah is ever Knowing and Wise; He admits whom He wills into His mercy but the wrongdoers He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا
